# Visa Migrate (OZ Sponsor Jobs) - Full LLM Knowledge Base

> Complete Guide to Australian Employer Visa Sponsorship, Accredited Sponsor Standards, and Live Vacancy Data.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose

Visa Migrate (https://www.visamigrate.com) is Australia's premier programmatic employment directory connecting international skilled workers, working holiday visa holders (Subclass 417/462), international graduate visa holders (Subclass 485), and onshore migrants with accredited Australian Standard Business Sponsors.

How listings are handled: vacancies come from Adzuna and Jooble feeds and are matched to a visa subclass and an ANZSCO occupation; the salary shown is the one from the original listing, or omitted when the listing gives none. We do not verify a sponsor's accreditation — check each employer yourself before applying. The minimum salary for most sponsored roles is the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT), AUD $79,423 from 1 July 2026, plus 12% superannuation. Occupations are checked against the Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL, 456 occupations) and the other skilled lists (MLTSSL, STSOL, ROL).

---

## 2. Australian Visa Framework Details

### Subclass 482 - Skills in Demand visa (formerly Temporary Skill Shortage – TSS)
- Purpose: Enables Australian employers to hire qualified international workers for approved positions where Australian workers are unavailable.
- Streams:
  - Core Skills Stream: Occupations on the Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL, 456 occupations); minimum salary CSIT $79,423.
  - Specialist Skills Stream: Highly skilled roles earning at least $135,000 a year.
  - Essential Skills Stream: For essential lower-paid roles, delivered through labour agreements.
  - Labour Agreement Stream: Sponsoring under negotiated sector or regional labour agreements (e.g. aged care, meat processing, DAMA).
- Transition to PR: Under the Migration Amendment (Subclass 482 and 186) Regulations, all Subclass 482 holders can transition to Australian Permanent Residency via the Temporary Residence Transition (TRT) stream of Subclass 186 after completing 2 years of full-time employment with their sponsoring employer.
- Hub URL: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-482-tss-jobs.html

### Subclass 186 - Employer Nomination Scheme (ENS) Visa
- Purpose: Direct Australian Permanent Residency for highly skilled workers nominated by an accredited Australian employer.
- Streams:
  - Direct Entry (DE) Stream: For skilled workers who have at least 3 years of relevant post-qualification experience and a positive skills assessment.
  - Temporary Residence Transition (TRT) Stream: For Subclass 482 TSS or Subclass 457 visa holders who have worked for their nominator for at least 2 out of the past 3 years.
- Hub URL: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-186-ens-jobs.html

### Subclass 494 - Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) Visa
- Purpose: Addresses critical skills shortages in regional Australia (any location outside Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane).
- Validity: 5-year provisional visa.
- Transition to PR: After completing 3 years of living, working, and earning a taxable income in a designated regional area, holders can transition to Permanent Residency via Subclass 191.
- Hub URL: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-494-regional-jobs.html

### DAMA (Designated Area Migration Agreements)
- Formal bilateral agreements between the Australian Federal Government and regional authorities to address specific local labour needs with visa concessions.
- Active DAMA regions include South Australia Regional, Adelaide City, Northern Territory (NT DAMA), Far North Queensland (FNQ DAMA), Pilbara, and Regional Victoria (Goulburn Valley).
- Hub URL: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/dama-visa-sponsorship-jobs-australia.html

## 3. High-Demand Occupations & Australian Cities

### Healthcare & Social Assistance (Australia's #1 Sponsorship Sector)
- Registered Nurses: Critical Care, Emergency, Aged Care, Mental Health, Perioperative, Paediatrics.
- Medical Practitioners: General Practitioners, Emergency Medicine, Anaesthetists, Psychiatrists.
- Allied Health: Occupational Therapists, Speech Pathologists, Physiotherapists, Sonographers, Radiographers.
- Sector Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/sectors/healthcare-nursing-medical-visa-sponsorship-jobs.html

### Information Technology (IT) & Software Engineering
- Software Developers: Full Stack, Java, Python, .NET.
- Data & Analytics: Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers.
- Cybersecurity: SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, Cloud Security Architects.
- Infrastructure: Site Reliability Engineers, Cloud Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Network Engineers.
- Sector Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/sectors/it-software-engineering-visa-sponsorship-jobs.html

### Skilled Trades & Construction
- Welders, Electricians, Heavy Diesel Mechanics, Metal Fabricators, Plumbers, Carpenters, Concreters, Scaffolders, Crane Operators.
- Sector Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/sectors/skilled-trades-technicians-visa-sponsorship-jobs.html

### Hospitality & Tourism
- Chefs, Pastry Chefs, Sous Chefs, Executive Chefs, Hotel & Restaurant Managers, Bar & Beverage Managers.
- Sector Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/sectors/hospitality-chefs-tourism-visa-sponsorship-jobs.html
